data.description: A shadow demon is utterly powerless in bright light or natural sunlight and flees from it. A shadow demon caught in such light cannot attack and can take only a single move or standard action. A shadow demon that is possessing a creature using magic jar is not harmed by sunlight, but if it is struck by a Sunbeam or Sunburst spell while possessing a creature, the shadow demon is driven out of its host automatically.
data.name: Sunlight Powerlessness
